script.title: PRICE MATCH PRO
script.story_hook: A phone screenshot nearly saves a busy shopper.
script.intro_zh: 一張手機截圖，能否省下一筆錢？
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today we ask a store to match a cheaper price. Listen for money words.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天我們請商店比照別家便宜的價格。留意金錢的說法。
script.outro: A fair price starts with a polite question. Compare, ask, win. See you soon!
script.outro_zh: 公道價從有禮的一問開始。比一比、問一問、就能省。下次見！
script.practice_intro_en: Hear it again and echo every line out loud.
script.practice_intro_zh: 再聽一次，每行都大聲跟著唸。
script.char_a_description: a college-age young man with messy dark brown hair under a gray beanie, an oversized red hoodie, thin frame, black-framed glasses, scuffed sneakers
script.char_b_description: a cheerful Latina woman in her fifties with silver-streaked black hair in a neat bun, a purple blazer over a white blouse, oval name badge, small gold earrings

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, what's your price-match policy?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz mi wʌts jʊɹ ˈpraɪs mætʃ ˈpɑləsi/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，你們有比價政策嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We match local paper ads. How close?
dialogue.phonetic: /wi mætʃ ˈloʊkəl ˈpeɪpɚ ædz haʊ kloʊs/
dialogue.zh: 我們比照當地的報紙廣告。差多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The same air fryer is forty-nine in town east.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə seɪm ɛɹ ˈfɹaɪɚ ɪz ˈfɔɹti naɪn ɪn taʊn ist/
dialogue.zh: 同款氣炸鍋在城東賣四十九。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is it? Ours says fifty-nine right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt aʊɹz sɛz ˈfɪfti naɪn raɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 是嗎？我們這邊標價是五十九。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I saved a screenshot — how do I show it?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ seɪvd ə ˈskɹinˌʃɑt haʊ du aɪ ʃoʊ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我存了截圖，要怎麼給你看？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, pull it up on your phone, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt pʊl ɪt ʌp ɑn jʊɹ foʊn pliːz/
dialogue.zh: 好，請把手機打開給我看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you match competitor ads here?
dialogue.phonetic: /duː ju mætʃ kəmˈpɛtɪtɚ ædz hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 你們會比照競爭對手的廣告嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, when the terms are the same.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wɛn ðə tɜɹmz ɑɹ ðə seɪm/
dialogue.zh: 可以，只要條件一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, this is the exact fryer.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ðɪs ɪz ði ɪɡˈzækt ˈfɹaɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 你看，就是這支氣炸鍋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First, is the ad still current?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜɹst ɪz ði æd stɪl ˈkɜɹənt/
dialogue.zh: 首先，廣告還在有效期嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, printed yesterday morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈpɹɪntɪd ˈjɛstɚˌdi ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 是的，昨天早上才印好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, let me take one look.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ lɛt mi teɪk wʌn lʊk/
dialogue.zh: 好，我看一眼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See? Forty-nine, that's the price there.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ˈfɔɹti naɪn ðæts ðə praɪs ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 看到沒？那邊賣四十九。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, ours is the six-quart model.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ˈaʊɹz ɪz ðə sɪks kwɔɹt ˈmɑdəl/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我們這台是六夸脫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The ad shows the eight-quart here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æd ʃoʊz ði eɪt kwɔɹt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 廣告上這台是八夸脫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, that's where we differ!
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæts wɛɹ wi dɪˈfɜɹ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，差別就在這裡！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So same model means same size, I see.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ seɪm ˈmɑdəl minz seɪm saɪz aɪ si/
dialogue.zh: 所以同款就得同容量，我懂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What do they charge for the eight-quart?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt du ðeɪ tʃɑɹdʒ fɚ ði eɪt kwɔɹt/
dialogue.zh: 他們八夸脫那台賣多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a different model number, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə ˈdɪfɹənt ˈmɑdəl ˈnʌmbɚ ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 廣告上是另一款，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it — sizes must match exactly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ˈsaɪzəz mʌst mætʃ ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 了解，尺寸要完全一致才行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I'd get it cheaper there?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪd ɡɛt ɪt ˈtʃipɚ ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 那我去買豈不更便宜？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or, we do have the eight-quart too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔɹ wi du hæv ði eɪt kwɔɹt tu/
dialogue.zh: 不過，我們也有八夸脫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? Still fifty-nine?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪli stɪl ˈfɪfti naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？還是五十九嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty-four today, without any match.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti fɔɹ təˈdeɪ wɪˈðaʊt ˈɛni mætʃ/
dialogue.zh: 今天是六十四，還沒算比價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, the smaller one is tempting, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ðə ˈsmɔlɚ wʌn ɪz ˈtɛmptɪŋ ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，不過小台的也很心動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight quarts is hard to store, to be fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt kwɔɹts ɪz hɑɹd tə stɔɹ tə bi fɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 說真的，八夸脫挺佔位置的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True, my counter space is tiny.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹu maɪ ˈkaʊntɚ speɪs ɪz ˈtaɪni/
dialogue.zh: 也是，我家流理台很小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The six-quart fits drawers, by the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sɪks kwɔɹt fɪts ˈdɹɔɹz baɪ ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對了，六夸脫收得進抽屜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, that settles it — six-quart, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ðæt ˈsɛtəlz ɪt sɪks kwɔɹt pliːz/
dialogue.zh: 好，就這樣決定了，拿六夸脫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart choice. It comes with a recipe card.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt tʃɔɪs ɪt kʌmz wɪð ə ˈɹɛsəpi kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 聰明的選擇。附一張食譜卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free with the purchase or extra?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹi wɪð ðə ˈpɜɹtʃəs ɔɹ ˈɛkstɹə/
dialogue.zh: 是買就送，還是要加錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free inside the box, already packed.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹi ɪnˈsaɪd ðə bɑks ɔlˈɛɾɪ pækt/
dialogue.zh: 免費，已經放在盒子裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this brand have a warranty too?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðɪs blænd hæv ə ˈwɔɹənɾi tu/
dialogue.zh: 這個品牌也有保固嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two years parts — we stand behind it.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu jɪɹz pɑɹts wi stænd bɪˈhaɪnd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 零件保固兩年，我們很有信心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The flyer ends today, clever of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈflaɪɚ ɛndz təˈdeɪ ˈklɛvɚ əv ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 海報今天就到期，他們真聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On purpose. Anything else you want to know?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ˈpɜɹpəs ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ɛls ju wɑnt tə noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 是故意的。還想問什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it quieter than my old one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt ˈkwaɪɾɚ ðæn maɪ oʊld wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 比我舊的那台安靜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quieter than a coffee grinder, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪɾɚ ðæn ə ˈkɔˌfi ˈɡɹaɪndɚ ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，比磨豆機還安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold. Oh no — the box has a big dent.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊld oʊ noʊ ðə bɑks hæz ə bɪɡ dɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 買了。噢不，盒子有個大凹陷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dents happen — we can knock off five more.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɛnts ˈhæpən wi kæn nɑk ɔːf faɪv mɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 難免的，還能再折五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It came like this from the warehouse, honest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt keɪm laɪk ðɪs fɚm ðə ˈwɛɹˌhaʊs ˈɑnəst/
dialogue.zh: 出倉時就這樣了，真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I believe you — damaged stock gets marked down.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ bɪˈliv ju ˈdæmɪdʒ stɑk ɡɛts ˈmɑɹkt daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 我相信你，破損品會降價賣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So... can we do anything about the price?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ kæn wi du ˈɛniˌθɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðə praɪs/
dialogue.zh: 那價位還能再談嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check with my boss, one moment.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk wɪð maɪ bɔːs wʌn ˈmoʊmənt/
dialogue.zh: 我問一下主管，稍等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course, take a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv ˈkɔɹs teɪk ə ˈmɪnɪt/
dialogue.zh: 當然，您慢慢來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, she approves both discounts today.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ʃi əˈpɹuvz boʊθ ˈdɪskaʊnts təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好，她批准兩個折扣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wonderful! So what's the final price?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌndɚfəl soʊ wʌts ðə ˈfaɪnəl praɪs/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！最後多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty-nine plus tax, thanks to your screenshot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔɹti naɪn plʌs tæks θæŋks tə jʊɹ ˈskɹinˌʃɑt/
dialogue.zh: 多虧你的截圖，四十九再加稅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing — do you take my app card?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ du ju teɪk maɪ æp kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，收手機裡的卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tap or insert, either is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tæp ɔɹ ɪnˈsɜɹt ˈiːðɚ ɪz faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 收的，貼一下或插卡都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, ring me up, I'm in a hurry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt ɹɪŋ mi ʌp aɪm ɪn ə ˈhɜɹi/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，請結帳，我趕時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One second, adding the air fryer now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈsɛkənd ˈædɪŋ ði ɛɹ ˈfɹaɪɚ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 等一下，正在輸入氣炸鍋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell the paper liners here?
dialogue.phonetic: /duː ju sɛl ðə ˈpeɪpɚ ˈlaɪnɚz hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 這裡有賣專用紙墊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the little red packs, grab it there.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈlɪɾəl ɹædz ɡɹæb ɪt ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 有，紅色小包裝，拿去結帳就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to join anything for this price?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə dʒɔɪn ˈɛniˌθɪŋ fɚ ðɪs praɪs/
dialogue.zh: 這個價位要先加入什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the app account is free to start.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ði æp əˈkaʊnt ɪz fɹi tə stɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 不用，手機會員免費開通。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I love a smooth deal — that's my lucky day.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lʌv ə smuːd dil ðæts maɪ ˈlʌki deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 交易真順利，今天好運氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All done, your receipt just emailed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl dʌn jʊɹ rɪˈsip dʒʌst ˈiːˌmeɪld/
dialogue.zh: 完成了，收據剛剛EMAIL給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for keeping it so easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɚ ˈkipɪŋ ɪt soʊ ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝您把流程變得這麼輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our pleasure — enjoy the fried chicken!
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊɚ ˈplɛʒɚ ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðə fɹaɪd ˈtʃɪkɪn/
dialogue.zh: 這是我們的榮幸，炸雞開心吃！

script.youtube_title: 【比價實戰】「你們會比照廣告價嗎？」氣炸鍋省錢記｜🎧60句聽力｜廣告比價、破損折價、會員優惠｜A2初級｜不用背多聽就會用｜Price Match Talk
script.youtube_title_en: "Do You Match Competitor Ads?" — Asking for a Price Match
script.youtube_description:
別家更便宜，可以讓商店照樣算錢嗎？這段「比價」美式英語聽力教你開口爭取！🎧

一位學生拿著手機截圖，想請店裡比照廣告價買氣炸鍋，結果發現兩家是不同容量，還出現盒子凹陷的新狀況。店長怎麼處理？你會聽到完整的一來一往。

這一集重現家電區的比價對話：查廣告效期、比同款同規格、破損再折價、手機付款與會員優惠，每句都不超過十個詞，A2 初級也能聽懂。

你會聽到：
🔸 開場詢問：Do you match competitor ads?
🔸 比價條件：Yes, when the terms are the same.
🔸 規格落差：Hmm, ours is the six-quart model.
🔸 破損折扣：We can knock off five more.

🎧 後半段是逐句聽力加跟讀練習，同一句先聽母語語調，再開口複製一次，把六十分鐘的句子聽到會說。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用，比價、折價、退差價的說法一次收集。

看完記得按讚、訂閱並打開小鈴鐺，每週新增一段生活情境聽力。留言告訴我們：你在國外比過價嗎？

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_en: Found it cheaper next door? Learn how to ask for a price match in real American English with this A2 listening practice. A student shows a store manager a screenshot of a flyer, but the two fryers turn out to hold different sizes, and a dented box adds a new twist. Listen to the whole negotiation: checking if the ad is still valid, matching the exact model, stacking a damage discount, paying by phone, and joining the free app for extra savings. Every sentence stays under ten words, so it is easy to follow and repeat. The second half of the video is a sentence-by-sentence listen-and-repeat training to move the phrases from your ears to your mouth. Subscribe for a new daily-life dialogue every week and tell us: have you ever asked for a price match while traveling?
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧比價英文｜比照廣告價・破損再折價・會員優惠券｜聽完就能說｜🌱A2初級英文｜💡不用背多聽就會用
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
看到別家廣告更便宜，可以要求商店照樣算錢嗎？盒子破損還能有折扣嗎？
這一集帶大家走進賣場家電區，跟著一位學生用一張手機截圖，層層推進一場有禮的比價交渉。
你會聽到：
🔸 開場詢問｜「Do you match competitor ads?」先確認政策再出示證據。
🔸 比價條件｜「Yes, when the terms are the same.」聽懂店家的同款同價要求。
🔸 規格落差｜「Hmm, ours is the six-quart model.」明白容量不同就不算同款。
🔸 破損折扣｜「We can knock off five more.」學會再壓一點價格的說法。

後半段是逐句聽力加跟讀練習 🎧 先聽母語語調，再開口複製，把六十分鐘的比價英語聽到會說。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用，下次看到海報廣告就能開口問。

願你的每一塊錢都花得明明白白。
script.thumbnail_expression: hopeful smile showing a phone screen
script.thumbnail_action: holding up a phone screenshot beside an air fryer box
